profileLabel: Liberal-leaning social values (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Quezon City 2nd District representative with 121 principal-authored bills. Authored a bill reinstating absolute divorce, an expansion of the Anti-Violence Against Women and Children Act, penalties for wage theft and a bill on gender equality and marriage sanctity.
caveat: Social score rests on two issues from titles; the gender equality and marriage sanctity bill is mixed in framing and was not scored. Wage theft is a single labor issue, so economic is not scored.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
